metadata.description: Two rows above the Claude Code prompt: a plan's progress, and your usage limits. Install either or both.

plugins.name: goal-meter
plugins.description: Progress row above the prompt: Claude lists the steps of a multi-step task, the row shows the title, bar, done of total and time; hover it for every step and its time.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Usage band above the prompt: 5-hour and 7-day limits, context window and prompt-cache hit rate, for the terminal and the desktop app.
